name: Auto Deco
description: One-click fill, outline and glow for the blocks you select in the editor.

fill.name: Fill
fill.description: Cover every selected block with a flat coloured square.

outline.name: Outline
outline.description: Draw a line along every block side that faces empty space, and close the gaps in inside corners.

glow.name: Glow
glow.description: Wrap the outside of the selected shape in glow, with proper pieces for outside and inside corners.

outline-style.name: Outline style
outline-style.description: Which set of outline objects to use. Custom uses the object IDs from the Advanced section.

glow-size.name: Glow size
glow-size.description: Which set of glow objects to use. Custom uses the object IDs from the Advanced section.

fill-color.name: Fill channel
fill-color.description: Colour channel ID for the fill. 1-999 are your own channels. 1010 is Black, 1011 is White, 1004 is Obj.

outline-color.name: Outline channel
outline-color.description: Colour channel ID for the outline. 1-999 are your own channels. 1010 is Black, 1011 is White, 1004 is Obj.

glow-color.name: Glow channel
glow-color.description: Colour channel ID for the glow. 1-999 are your own channels. 1010 is Black, 1011 is White, 1004 is Obj.

block-z-layer.name: Fill and outline Z layer
block-z-layer.description: Fill sits at Z order 1 and the outline at Z order 2 on this layer, so they cover the layout blocks underneath.

editor-layer.name: Editor layer
editor-layer.description: Editor layer the generated objects are put on, so decoration can be hidden or locked separately from the layout.

no-touch.name: No Touch
no-touch.description: Mark generated objects as No Touch so decoration can never change the gameplay.

auto-orient.name: Detect piece orientation
auto-orient.description: Look at each decoration sprite to work out which way it faces before placing it. Leave on unless pieces come out wrong.

max-objects.name: Object limit per run
max-objects.description: Refuse to run if a single press would add more objects than this.

custom-outline-edge.name: Custom outline: edge ID
custom-outline-edge.description: Used when Outline style is Custom. A straight line along one side of a block.

custom-outline-inner.name: Custom outline: inside corner ID
custom-outline-inner.description: Used when Outline style is Custom. The small piece that closes an inside corner.
